rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, explicit issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each material owner-resolved boundary and each supported user-visible outcome, including relevant compatibility preservation. Treat later patches and tests only as evidence: they may confirm a specific outcome, regression boundary, or causal diagnosis, but cannot make their exact inputs, private-helper results, code structure, algorithms, predicates, representations, messages, documentation, refactors, or test organization mandatory. Do not generalize beyond the evidenced cases or convert a successful patch choice into a requirement. Penalize omitted material decisions, unsupported scope, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that produces the supported observable behavior.
